meta.title: µm to AU Converter — Micrometer to Astronomical Unit
meta.description: Convert Micrometer (µm) to Astronomical Unit (AU) instantly. 1 µm = 6.684587e-18 AU. Free, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: Convert micrometers (µm) to astronomical units (AU) instantly. Both measure length, so the relationship is strictly linear: each micrometer equals 6.684587e-18 astronomical units. Use the converter above for any value, or read on for the formula, a quick lookup table, and practical tips.
content.result_section: One micrometer is equal to **6.684587e-18 astronomical units**. To go the other way, one astronomical unit equals **1.495979e+17 micrometers**. For everyday use, rounding to 2–4 decimal places is usually enough; for engineering or scientific work, keep the full precision shown by the converter.
content.formula_section:
The conversion is a single multiplication:

> astronomical units = micrometers × 6.684587e-18

Worked example — converting 10 micrometers:

10 × 6.684587e-18 = **6.684587e-17 AU**.

To invert, divide by 6.684587e-18 (or multiply by 1.495979e+17).
content.use_cases:
- Cooking and recipe conversions when switching between metric and imperial measurements.
- Travel planning where signage and maps use different unit systems.
- DIY and home-improvement projects that mix metric materials with imperial tools.
- Fitness tracking when devices report in one system and goals are set in another.
- Shipping and logistics where weight and dimensions drive cost.
content.tips:
Keep the factor handy: 1 µm ≈ 6.684587e-18 AU. For rough mental math, round to the nearest sensible digit.

Mind the units. Micrometer and Astronomical Unit both measure length; squared or cubic variants need a different factor (factor², factor³).

When precision matters (engineering, lab work, dosing), avoid rounding mid-calculation — convert once at the final step using the full factor.
content.faq:
**Q:** How many astronomical units are in 1 micrometer?
**A:** 6.684587e-18 astronomical units.

**Q:** What's the formula to convert µm to AU?
**A:** astronomical units = micrometers × 6.684587e-18.

**Q:** How do I convert AU back to µm?
**A:** Multiply by 1.495979e+17 (or divide by 6.684587e-18).

**Q:** Is rounding to 2 decimal places accurate enough?
**A:** For most everyday uses, yes. For scientific or engineering work, use the full precision from the converter.

**Q:** Does this µm to AU converter work offline?
**A:** Yes — all math runs in your browser, no network required after the page loads.
